page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Running head top centre; page number top right. Catchword "runt" at the lower right, below the last line. Signature at the foot, left of centre.

main_text.p: sit 14. aut 70. Diebus, nulla quaestio est, si textus aliquis est authentice punctata-tus. Nam diserte Scriptura dicit duabus septimanis שבעים. Pone textum non punctatum שבעים. Tum gravissima quaestio, nam & 70. dies & dua[?]eptima-nae intelligi possunt. Sic & de בור[?] & aliis pluribus. Huc referri debet invi-ctum meo judicio ex S. Hieronymo ar-gumentum in Hierem cap. 9. v. 22. Verbum Hebraicum, quod tribus litteris scri-bitur דבר, vocales enim in medio non ha-bet, pro consequentia & legentis arbitrio, si legatur dabar, sermonem significat, si deber mortem, si daber loquere. Unde & 70. & Theodotio junxerunt illud praeterito capitulo, ut dicerent disperdent parvulos de foris, juvenes de plateis morte. Aquila vero & Symmachus transtulerunt λάλη-σον, id est, loquere. Si puncta fuissent in-scripta, ita ne potuisset loqui S. Hiero-nymus דבר pro consequentis & legen-tis arbitrio potest legi דבר aut דבר. Dicet aliquis, codex S. Hieronymi non erat punctatus, sed si aliqvi codices fue-

page.notes: Hebrew words are printed inside boxes in the scan; the first and second "שבעים" differ in vowel pointing and are transcribed as shown. "dua" is partly covered by an ink spot, so the letter after it is doubtful. The "בור" after "de" is not fully clear. Catchword "runt" and signature "Aa 5" are read from the foot of the page and the signature is doubtful. Spelling "qvod", "aliqvi", "loqvi" are printed with v, kept as printed in the Latin where the u/v rule applies to consonants; "loquere" and "loqui" were copied as printed.
